attributes.title: ARN's 2027 Rehabilitation Nursing Conference
attributes.summary:
ARN's 2027 Rehabilitation Nursing Conference is a hybrid event: live virtual sessions on July 29 and 30, 2027, followed by the in-person meeting in New Orleans on August 7 to 9, 2027. Recordings of both parts stay available on demand through the end of the year.

The Association of Rehabilitation Nurses is accredited by ANCC as a provider of continuing nursing education, and the conference is built around earning CE in both formats. The venue, number of contact hours and registration fees are not published yet; ARN mentions group discounts for members and non-members.
